roles.title: Research Assistant - Software Developer
roles.description: Builds full-stack features with Next.js, React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL and Supabase.
highlights: Cut average API query execution time by 65% by redesigning relational schemas, adding indexes and refining complex queries in PostgreSQL and Supabase.
Reduced initial page load latency by 35% with Next.js, React and TypeScript features built on RESTful APIs and reusable components.
Protected more than 1 million user records with a secure multi-tenant design using PostgreSQL Row-Level Security, database functions and role-based access controls.
Reduced manual deployment effort by 40% and release time from 30 minutes to 4 minutes with GitHub Actions and AWS S3 workflows.

roles.title: Software Development Engineer
roles.description: Backend engineer on enterprise compliance workflows and API platform infrastructure.
highlights: Engineered Java, Spring Boot and MySQL backend components for Jio's Tax Filing Portal, serving 20,000+ users and cutting tax submission processing time by up to 70 minutes per user.
Provisioned and configured WSO2 API Gateway infrastructure, including server setup, network routing, dependencies and security certificate integration.
Coordinated API onboarding and gateway configuration across 5+ engineering teams, with OAuth/JWT authentication, rate limiting and deployment verification.
Reduced mean time to resolution by 30% by diagnosing defects and performance bottlenecks through log analysis and application monitoring.
